rater: single-rater: claude (agent), 2026-06-16, labeled by direct render inspection beside each concept. Single-rater honest — this is one rater's ground truth, NOT inter-rater agreement (no aggregation logic exists or is implied). A limitation, recorded as such (S-167 note).
notes: E-40 / S-167 labeled defect corpus. 8 states: 4 single-defect (worst construction department) + 4 wrong-style pairs (pairwise more-faithful). Spans roof / structural-integrity / surface-relief / opening, plus palette+style via the wrong-style pairs. GAP, stated honestly: massing/proportion is NOT a construction department (the S-163 decision — no idiom resizes a mass), so no clean single-department massing-worst state exists; massing-dominated candidates are in `excluded`, which is itself the multi-label signal the S-167 falsifiable claim asks us to report. Wrong-style pairs sit on CLEAN builds (a present, reading roof) so they test style distance, not a missing-roof confound — the corpus is not gated on the roof. Count is fixed at 8 by contract for S-168/S-169 stability.
